widgets_values: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production icon for the Lightning spell in a medieval pixel-art idle RPG. It depicts the EFFECT, not a caster: a strong angular pale-blue lightning bolt descending diagonally from a compact slate storm cloud, with two shorter branching sparks below. Single unmistakable silhouette. Square composition, motif occupies 75% of the canvas with generous safe margin. Faithful hand-placed pixel art on a 48 by 48 logical pixel grid enlarged with nearest-neighbor: visible square pixel clusters, clean stair-step edges, no antialiasing, no gradients. At most 16 colors: dark desaturated indigo/slate for cloud and depth, muted steel blue and dusty cyan, a few warm ivory highlights. Readable at 48px next to wood-and-bronze UI; restrained brightness, no neon, no bloom haze. Plain uniform very dark charcoal background #171c24. No frame, no text, no numbers, no character, no glyphs, no logo, no tiny glitter noise, no ornamental filigree. Flat icon, not a mockup.
